description: Stereo filter morphed through a cube: each corner of the cube holds the settings of up to seven filters, and the three axis knobs move between the corners

params.text: Picks which cube of filter settings is used, numbered from zero through the cubes in the loaded file
Moves the first channel along the frequency axis of the cube, 0 to 100% on a logarithmic scale
Moves the first channel along the Y axis of the cube, 0 to 100%
Moves the first channel along the Z axis of the cube, 0 to 100%
Moves the second channel along the frequency axis of the cube, 0 to 100% on a logarithmic scale, and LINK replaces this setting with the first channel one
Moves the second channel along the Y axis of the cube, 0 to 100%, and LINK replaces this setting with the first channel one
Moves the second channel along the Z axis of the cube, 0 to 100%, and LINK replaces this setting with the first channel one
Makes the second channel use the first row of FREQUENCY, Y and Z in place of the second row, so both channels are filtered alike
Turns the two inputs into their sum and their difference before filtering and back into left and right after, so the first row filters the middle and the second the sides

inputs.text: The left channel into the filter, or the middle of the stereo image when MID-SIDE is on
The right channel into the filter, or the sides of the stereo image when MID-SIDE is on; nothing is normalled here, so it reads 0V unpatched
Adds to the model number, 10V covering every cube in the loaded file
Adds to the first channel's position on the frequency axis, 10V covering the whole axis
Adds to the first channel's position on the Y axis, 10V covering the whole axis
Adds to the first channel's position on the Z axis, 10V covering the whole axis
Adds to the second channel's position on the frequency axis, 10V covering the whole axis
Adds to the second channel's position on the Y axis, 10V covering the whole axis
Adds to the second channel's position on the Z axis, 10V covering the whole axis

outputs.text: The filtered left channel, clamped to ±10V
The filtered right channel, clamped to ±10V

notes: a default set of filter cubes ships with the plugin and is read in as soon as the module is placed, so no file has to be chosen before it will work
menu: Load Model Cube File — replaces the filter cubes with a set read from a JSON file of your own; the plugin folder holds the default file and a note on writing one
